name: dev100
note: Second development set. Frozen 2026-08-18, BEFORE the heldout100 run — results/raw/two_stage_hydrated.heldout100.jsonl did not exist when this was drawn, so nothing here was chosen by looking at a held-out outcome. It exists because dev50 is exhausted (it chose prompts, gates, the fallback design, and six modules NOT to build) and heldout100 is spendable exactly once. Without a third set, every post-held-out experiment — extraction batch size, temporal context composition — would have to be run against the held-out set, which would silently convert it into a second development set. Drawn stratified over the 350 questions that dev50 and heldout100 did not take, so all three are disjoint by construction. This set is for iterating on; it is NOT a reportable headline number.
